title: Event-linked Overnight Gap and Multi-day Price-limit Exit PIT Feasibility Audit
purpose: Validate Taiwan PIT/source feasibility for event-linked overnight gap risk and price-limit-constrained multi-day exit risk without duplicating D04/D05/D17 evidence or opening return outcomes.

dailyA1.evidence: TWSE MI_INDEX and TPEx dailyQuotes historical sources have live-validated requested-date/source-date equality and OHLC integrity across old and recent sessions.
dailyA1.inheritedUse: D11 may consume the same observed opening-gap primitive but may not count it as an independent second alpha vote.

corporateActionFirewall.rule: Known mechanical reference-price resets must be separated from residual market gap. Unresolved action/reference continuity => UNKNOWN/BLOCKED.

eventClock.rule: Event identity, sourcePublishedAt/capturedAt, scheduled/exact/deadline/unscheduled state and effective clocks remain distinct. capturedAt is conservative where native availability is unproven.

priceLimitMechanics.evidence: Current TWSE Article 63 uses ±10% around the session opening auction reference price for stocks, subject to explicit exceptions including newly listed common-stock no-limit periods. Existing research quote chain physically preserves limit flags, best bid/ask, top-five depth, timestamps, halt/trial/delayed states.
priceLimitMechanics.boundary: D11-11 owns only the exit/executability transformation, not the exchange mechanics or volatility contamination.

D11_10.name: Overnight Gap跳空事件風險
D11_10.primitiveOwner: The opening gap is one shared primitive observation also used by D04-09 and later D17-12 path analysis.
D11_10.transformationOwner: D11-10 owns whether a PIT-valid event exposure window is linked to the next observed opening discontinuity and whether continuous-price stop assumptions are unsafe.
pitContract: Use only prior eligible close and next observed official open; synthetic open is prohibited.
Event first-known clock must be available before the next-opening analysis cutoff and after the relevant prior decision cutoff for an overnight realization classification.
A pre-announced event may be known before close while its realization arrives after close; schedule knowledge and realization knowledge remain separate.
Known corporate-action reference reset is tagged MECHANICAL and cannot become event-gap evidence.
Unresolved corporate action, missing open, unexplained missing session or unresolved suspension provenance => UNKNOWN/BLOCKED.
Market/sector overnight context is a control, not a duplicate directional vote.
divergentStates: Large observed gap with no verified event in a covered lane: market gap exists, D11 event linkage remains UNKNOWN/NO_VERIFIED_LINK rather than event evidence.
Small gap after a major event: event exposure exists but realized gap risk is small.
Large corporate-action mechanical reset: D04 raw gap may exist while D11-10 event-risk gap is blocked from economic-event interpretation.
Large global market gap with same-direction stock gap: common-shock control may explain most of the opening move.

maturityDecision.basis: Taiwan official daily OHLC replay, PIT-capable event clocks and the D11-12 corporate-action firewall jointly make event-linked overnight gap construction causally reproducible with explicit UNKNOWN states.

D11_11.name: 漲跌停造成多日退出風險
D11_11.primitiveOwner: D05-02 owns price-limit mechanics; D04-10 owns volatility-estimator contamination from limit constraints.
D11_11.transformationOwner: D11-11 owns only whether a position's exit is observably constrained across one or more sessions.
pitContract: A close at the lower price limit does not prove that a sell order was impossible to execute.
Prospective quote evidence may classify immediate displayed executability using timestamped best bid and displayed depth; it does not prove queue position or full-session fillability.
Actual realized fill requires order/fill evidence; absent order evidence remains ACTUAL_ORDER_FILL_UNKNOWN.
MULTIDAY_CONSTRAINT_SEQUENCE requires consecutive session-level source receipts under the same frozen definition; one limit-hit day cannot be multiplied into a hypothetical multi-day lock.
No-limit IPO periods, reference-price exceptions, halts, delayed opens/closes and trial states remain separate rule/mechanism states.
Historical daily OHLC alone cannot reconstruct historical order-book/queue state; such fillability remains UNKNOWN rather than backfilled.
divergentStates: Limit-down price with positive executable bid depth: limit event exists but immediate exit may still be possible for some quantity.
Limit-down price with no displayed executable bid at the observation timestamp: bounded market-exit constraint is observed, but full-day impossibility still requires broader coverage.
Large position exceeds displayed bid depth: partial executability differs from zero executability.
Halt/suspension prevents execution for a different mechanism and must not be relabeled as price-limit trapping.
New listing in a no-price-limit period invalidates the ordinary ±10% assumption.

maturityDecision.basis: Current official price-limit rule/version evidence plus physically validated timestamped quote/depth/limit/mechanism states make prospective exit-constraint observation and multi-session sequencing feasible. Historical exact queue/fill replay is not claimed.

antiDoubleCount.H15: D11-10 event-linked overnight risk, D04-09 tail/gap volatility state and D17-12 post-gap path share one opening-gap primitive. They are not three votes at event time zero.
antiDoubleCount.H16: D05-02 price-limit mechanics, D11-11 exit constraint, D01-09 chart semantics and D04-10 volatility contamination share one limit-hit primitive. Only downstream transformations differ.

incrementalValueTestBeforeL4: D11-10 must show event-timing context adds information beyond raw gap magnitude, market/sector gap controls and D04-09 tail state.
D11-11 must show verified exit-constraint state adds decision value beyond simple limit-hit flags, liquidity/spread/depth states and ordinary stop-distance risk.
Use common-support prospective dates and freeze definitions before outcomes.
exactNext: D11-10: build prospective event->next-open receipts across scheduled and unscheduled events, with corporate-action and market/sector controls, then preregister gap-through-stop outcomes.

D11-11: accumulate prospective timestamped limit/bid-depth states across actual consecutive constrained sessions; join real order/fill evidence only where available; keep historical exact fillability UNKNOWN.
D11-16 remains blocked on issuer-level custody-release-to-realized-supply chain.
